policy.adds_only: The sidecar adds ids. It never edits graph.json and never overrides a fixed number (capacity, share, transit, queue_cap, inventory_days).
policy.claims: Structure only. No accuracy claim follows from this file.
policy.engine2_view: core places + core_ext places and core_ext legs only; shell places and legs are dropped, exactly as core_subgraph drops them for graph.json shells.
policy.lanes: Dormant (capacity_share 0): carried as engine rev 2 reroute-lane specs, used only when the primary leg's forecast wait exceeds the lane's added days. Route lengths are MODELLED geometry; the split among alternatives is not sourced.
policy.opt_in: Consumed only when a run asks: `extra` on /sim/run (view sim) or on a rev-2 /run (view engine2). Journaled (file sha256, view, lane families) only when used; absent, every id and byte is unchanged.
policy.shares: capacity_share of every new leg is a MODELED rule output (S1-S6, R-CAP), not data.
policy.sim_view: Every sidecar place enters the sim as shell. A core_ext leg is WITHHELD from the sim view: derive() sizes its headway bands from the core-core lane population, so a core-core addition would move the band of existing lanes. It is visible to engine rev 2 instead.
policy.tiers: core_ext = engine-visible, structural, NOT calibration-grade. A sidecar leg between two core / core_ext places is core_ext; any leg touching a shell place is shell. The graph's 200 core / 792 shell split is unchanged. No place of this slice is core_ext (the four core_ext chokepoints of the candidates are outside the first slice).

position_notes.note: graph.json places Bremerhaven at Wilhelmshaven's position (28.2 km from the registry's Bremerhaven, 1.2 km from its Wilhelmshaven). this note is not applied to the graph: the sidecar changes no coordinate, and the fix belongs in a graph rebuild. Consequence carried here: sea_wilhelmshaven has a same_complex_override and sits 1.2 km from CORE sea_bremerhaven in any merged view.
